title: Grant Opportunities, Products & Workflow Templates
summary: This capability lets the foundation design and run its grant opportunities of three kinds: project grants, in-kind product grants and tendered projects (RFP) where the foundation defines the project and invites partners to submit offers. For each opportunity the Grants Manager defines the budget, reception window, who is eligible, the review workflow, evaluation criteria, application form and the defaults used when an approved application becomes a project. Reusable workflow templates, an organization product catalog with stock control, private invitations and evidence-backed configuration changes make opportunities faster to launch, consistent to review and fully auditable.

process.title: Grant opportunity lifecycle
process.mermaid:
flowchart LR

use_cases.name: Monitor the grant opportunities portfolio and performance
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want to see all grant opportunities with their reception status, budget, applications and stage performance so that I can manage intake and act on delays.
use_cases.description: The opportunities list gives the Grants Manager the portfolio view: number of opportunities, total applications and total budgets, plus each opportunity's kind, reception window, budget, open/closed status, publication and number of applications. Each opportunity has a summary showing applications by outcome, requested versus approved amounts, days left, applications per stage with delays, and top applicant partners and regions.
preconditions: The user is signed in with a role allowed to view grant opportunities.
use_cases.trigger: The user selects «فرص المنح» in the grants section or from global search.
scenario: The system shows the portfolio indicators: number of opportunities, total applications and total budgets.
The system lists the organization's opportunities with title, kind, targeted badge, reception window, budget, reception status (open/closed), publication switch and number of applications.
The user hovers over the «مستهدفة» badge to see a summary of who is targeted.
The user opens an opportunity; the system shows its summary tab.
The system shows applications, approved, closed, approved versus requested amount versus budget, and days remaining until closing.
The system shows applications per workflow stage with current, late and average duration.
The system shows the top 5 applicant partners and top 5 regions and, for product opportunities, requested versus delivered quantities per product.
The user publishes or unpublishes an opportunity from the list when authorised.
alternative_flows: If there are no applications yet, the summary shows «لا توجد طلبات بعد.»
If the opportunity does not exist, the system shows a not-found message (Recommended).
business_requirements: The system must list only the opportunities of the user's own organization.
The system must show the number of opportunities, total applications and total budgets.
The system must show each opportunity as open only when it is active, published and the current time is within its reception window; otherwise as closed.
The system must clearly mark opportunities that are restricted by targeting and summarise the targeting, including account types.
The system should provide search, filtering and sorting of the opportunities list (Recommended).
The system must show per opportunity: applications, approved, closed, approved versus requested amount versus budget, and days left.
The system must show applications per stage using the opportunity's own stage names and its own stage time limits.
The system must show the top applicant partners and regions and, for product opportunities, requested versus delivered quantities.
The system must allow only authorised roles to publish or unpublish an opportunity, and must record the change (To be confirmed whether evidence is required).
use_cases.postconditions: The user knows the status and performance of every opportunity and can open any of them for configuration.

use_cases.name: Create a grant opportunity
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want a guided flow to create an opportunity with its kind, budget, reception window and a default workflow so that it is ready to configure in minutes.
use_cases.description: A four-step guided flow creates a new opportunity: identity (title, kind, description), dates and budget (including whether it is a general opportunity), a preview of the default workflow and evaluation criteria, and a final review. The AI Assistant can propose the fields from a free-text description. The opportunity is created with a standard three-stage workflow and three weighted criteria, and opens for further configuration.
preconditions: The user is authorised to create opportunities (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user selects «فرصة جديدة» on the opportunities list.
scenario: Optionally, the user describes the opportunity in free text and the AI Assistant proposes title, kind, description, budget and dates; the user applies the values they accept.
Step 1 «هوية الفرصة»: the user enters the title, selects the kind (مشروع, منتجات or مشروع مطروح) and an optional description.
Step 2 «المواعيد والميزانية»: the user enters the budget and the reception start and end, and indicates whether it is a general opportunity («فرصة عامة»).
Step 3 «سير الإجراء ومعايير المفاضلة»: the system shows the default stages with supervisors and time limits, and the default criteria; the user confirms.
Step 4 «المراجعة والإنشاء»: the system summarises the opportunity; the user selects «إنشاء الفرصة».
The system creates the opportunity with its default workflow and criteria, as an unpublished draft.
The system confirms «أُنشئت الفرصة» and opens the opportunity for configuration.
alternative_flows: The user can go back to a previous step at any time with «السابق».
If the user closes the flow, no opportunity is created.
business_requirements: The system must require a title, a kind, a budget greater than zero, and a reception start and end with the end after the start.
The system must not allow moving to the next step until the current step is valid.
The system must offer the three kinds: project grant, product (in-kind) grant and tendered project (RFP), each with a short explanation.
The system must allow marking the opportunity as general (not tied to one initiative).

The system must create every new opportunity with the standard workflow: (1) receiving applications – 3 days, (2) studying applications by evaluation criteria – 5 days, (3) approving applications – 3 days.
The system must create every new opportunity with the default criteria: clarity of objectives 30%, expected impact 40%, financial feasibility 30%.
The system must create new opportunities as unpublished drafts that require an explicit publish action.
The system must assign default stage supervisors from the user's own organization.
The system should offer AI-assisted proposal of fields, applied only on user confirmation.
The system should validate the opportunity budget against the available balance of the linked plan item (To be confirmed).

errors.name: Invalid reception window
errors.description: If the end of reception is not after the start, the system shows an inline message and keeps «التالي» disabled.

errors.name: Creation failure
errors.description: If the opportunity cannot be created, the system shows an error message and keeps the entered data.

use_cases.postconditions: A new draft opportunity exists with a default workflow and criteria and is ready for configuration.

fields.notes: مشروع / منتجات / مشروع مطروح; cannot be changed later (To be confirmed)
Greater than zero; ceiling for RFP offers
Applicant chooses the initiative when applying

use_cases.name: Maintain opportunity information, reception window and status
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want to edit an opportunity's basic information, quota, reception window, publication and active status so that it reflects the approved announcement and I can stop or resume intake.
use_cases.description: Within an evidence-backed edit session, the Grants Manager updates the opportunity's title, description, budget, maximum applications per partner, announcement date, reception window, target account types, eligibility conditions, publication and active status. Closing an opportunity early or reactivating it is done through the active switch. The general/initiative-specific setting and the default plan item determine how applications are charged to the annual plan.
preconditions: The user is authorised to edit opportunities (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user opens the opportunity, selects «تعديل» and goes to «المعلومات الأساسية».
scenario: The user starts an edit session on the opportunity.
The user updates title, description, budget and the maximum number of applications per partner.
The user updates the announcement date and the reception start and end.
The user selects the target account types and enters any free-text eligibility conditions.
The user sets the publication and active switches.
The user selects «حفظ»; the system validates the data and confirms «تم حفظ بيانات الفرصة».
The user saves the edit session with the evidence document (see PRG-10).
alternative_flows: Close early: the user switches «نشطة» off; the opportunity stops accepting applications regardless of its window.
Reactivate: the user switches «نشطة» on; the opportunity reopens if it is published and within its window.
Extend: the user moves the reception end to a later date; the opportunity reopens if active and published.
General flag: while no applications exist, the user can change whether the opportunity is general or initiative-specific (Recommended).
business_requirements: The system must validate that the reception end is after the start, the budget is greater than zero and the maximum applications per partner is at least 1.
The system must determine reception status automatically from the active status, publication and reception window.
The system must allow closing an opportunity early and reactivating it.
The system should close opportunities automatically at the end of the reception window (To be confirmed).
The system must show and allow changing the general/initiative-specific setting while no applications exist.
The system must require applicants on a general opportunity to choose the plan initiative, and charge applications on an initiative-specific opportunity to its default plan item.
The system must not allow changing the opportunity kind after creation (To be confirmed).
The system must record every change with before and after values, actor, date and evidence document.
The system should define the purpose of the announcement date and free-text eligibility conditions, e.g. display in the partner portal (To be confirmed).

errors.name: Invalid data
errors.description: If the window, budget or quota is invalid, the system blocks saving and highlights the field (Recommended).

errors.name: Save failure
errors.description: If saving fails, the system shows the error and keeps the entered data.

use_cases.postconditions: The opportunity's information, window and status are updated and the change is recorded in its history.

fields.notes: جمعية أهلية، مؤسسة أهلية، شركة / مؤسسة تجارية، شركة غير ربحية، وقف، المجالس الأهلية، جهة حكومية، فرد، أخرى

use_cases.name: Define eligibility targeting and application quota
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want to target an opportunity by classification, region, governorate, governance score, partner groups or named partners so that only intended partners can apply.
use_cases.description: The Grants Manager defines who may apply: partner groups, national classification groups and sub-classifications, regions, governorates or cities, a minimum governance score and named partners. Partners named explicitly or belonging to a targeted group are always eligible; other rules must all be met. In the partner portal each partner sees which open opportunities they qualify for, the reasons if not, and how many applications they have left.
preconditions: The opportunity exists and is in an edit session.
Partner profiles hold up-to-date classification, region and governance data.
use_cases.trigger: The user opens «الجمعيات المستهدفة» in the opportunity's basic information.
scenario: The user selects targeted partner groups, classification groups and sub-classifications.
The user selects regions and then governorates or cities within them.
The user optionally sets a minimum governance score and names specific partners.
The system shows a live plain-language summary of the targeting; leaving everything empty means open to all.
The user saves the opportunity and the edit session.
A partner opens the portal; the system shows open opportunities with eligibility, reasons for ineligibility and «قدّمت x من y».
An eligible partner within quota selects «تقديم طلب»; the system re-checks eligibility, window and quota on submission.
alternative_flows: If the partner is ineligible, the apply action is disabled and reasons are listed.
If the partner reached the quota, the system shows «استنفدت عدد الطلبات المسموحة».
If only named partners or groups are targeted, all other partners see «هذه الفرصة مخصصة لجمعيات محددة».
business_requirements: The system must allow targeting by partner groups, classification groups, sub-classifications, regions, governorates/cities, minimum governance score, account types and named partners.
The system must treat an empty targeting rule as open to all.
The system must make partners named explicitly or belonging to a targeted group always eligible.
The system must make all other partners ineligible when only named partners or groups are targeted.
The system must require all other non-empty rules to be met, and must treat a partner without a governance score as failing a minimum governance rule.
The system must evaluate group membership at the time of the check.
The system must show partners the reasons they are not eligible.
The system must limit each partner to the allowed number of non-cancelled applications per opportunity (which statuses count to be confirmed).
The system must enforce eligibility, reception window and quota at submission, not only on screen.
The system must re-validate eligibility, window and quota when a partner applies through an invitation link (To be confirmed whether invited partners may bypass the window).

errors.name: Not eligible
errors.description: The system shows the failed rules, e.g. «مخصصة لـ: …», «مخصصة لتصنيف: …», «تتطلب درجة حوكمة … فأعلى», «مخصصة لمحافظة: …».

errors.name: Quota exhausted
errors.description: The system shows «استنفدت عدد الطلبات المسموحة» and disables applying.

use_cases.postconditions: Only eligible partners within quota can submit applications to the opportunity.

use_cases.name: Configure the opportunity workflow, evaluation, form and post-approval defaults
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want to set each stage's approval type, time limit, supervisors and allowed actions, the evaluation criteria and pass score, the application form and the transfer defaults so that applications are reviewed consistently and approved ones become projects without manual setup.
use_cases.description: Each opportunity has its own review workflow. For each stage the Grants Manager chooses the approval type (supervisors, evaluation criteria or committee), the committee and its secretary where applicable, the time limit in days, the supervisors and the actions reviewers may take. The manager also maintains weighted evaluation criteria and the pass score, attaches one form from the organization's form library, and sets defaults used when an approved application is transferred to a project.
preconditions: The opportunity exists and is in an edit session.
No applications are in progress, or the change is allowed by the versioning policy (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user opens the «سير الإجراءات», «معايير التقييم», «نموذج التقديم» or «الإعدادات الافتراضية» tab in edit mode.
scenario: For each stage, the user selects the approval type: «المشرفين», «معايير التقييم» or «موافقة لجنة».
For a committee stage, the user enters the committee name and selects the committee secretary.
The user sets the stage time limit in days and selects the supervisors.
The user sets the allowed actions: return, close, skip stage, edit application, return to applicant for edits, attach file.
The user adds or removes evaluation criteria with their weights and sets the pass score; the system shows the weight total.
The user selects the application form from the organization library and previews its fields.
The user sets whether a contract is required, the default project manager, the contract officer and the default annual plan item.
The user saves the edit session with the evidence document (see PRG-10).
alternative_flows: For product opportunities, the contract switch is hidden because product grants end in delivery, not a project.
If the user selects «بدون نموذج إضافي», applicants fill only the standard application data.
business_requirements: The system must allow each stage's approval type to be supervisors, evaluation criteria or committee.
The system must require a committee name and committee secretary for committee stages; the stage's applications go to the secretary and are approved with one set of minutes.
The system must allow setting a time limit in days per stage and consider an application late when it exceeds it.
The system must allow assigning supervisors from the organization's staff only.
The system must apply the allowed-action settings (return, close, skip, edit, return to applicant, attach) in the review screens.
The system must require criteria weights to total 100% and a pass score between 0 and 100 before saving or publishing.
The system must allow editing, reordering and deleting criteria, with confirmation before deletion.
The system must allow one form from the organization's form library per opportunity, maintained only in the library.

The system must apply transfer defaults: create a contract only when required, assign the default project manager, and charge the project to the application's plan item or the opportunity's default plan item.
The system must prevent structural workflow changes once applications exist, or keep a version of the workflow per application (To be confirmed).
The system should support a variable number of stages and stage renaming (To be confirmed).
The system must record all changes in the opportunity's configuration history.

errors.name: Weights not 100%
errors.description: If criteria weights do not total 100%, the total is shown in red and saving/publishing is blocked (Recommended).

errors.name: Missing committee data
errors.description: If a committee stage has no committee name or secretary, the system blocks saving (Recommended).

use_cases.postconditions: The opportunity has a complete review workflow, evaluation scheme, form and transfer defaults.

fields.ar: السماح بالإرجاع / بالإغلاق / بتخطي المرحلة / بتعديل الطلب / إرجاع للتعديل إلى المتقدم / بإرفاق ملف
fields.notes: Defaults: return, close, return to applicant and attach = Yes; skip and edit = No
From the form library or «بدون نموذج إضافي»
Default Yes; hidden for product grants

use_cases.name: Manage workflow templates and apply them to opportunities
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want a library of reusable workflow templates that I can apply to an opportunity and whose performance I can analyse so that opportunities get a proven process in one step and bottlenecks are visible.
use_cases.description: Workflow templates («محركات سير الإجراء») bundle stages, time limits, evaluation criteria and a pass score. The Grants Manager creates and maintains templates, applies one to an opportunity (which copies its content into the opportunity), and analyses each template's performance across the opportunities that use it. A template used by any opportunity cannot be deleted.
preconditions: The user is authorised to maintain workflow templates (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user opens «محركات سير الإجراء», or uses «تطبيق محرك من المكتبة» on an opportunity's workflow tab.
scenario: The system lists the organization's templates with number of stages, number of criteria, pass score and number of opportunities using each.
The user selects «محرك جديد», enters a name and selects «إنشاء»; the system creates a template with standard stages and opens it.
In edit mode, the user renames the template, sets stage time limits and adds or removes criteria with a weight-total indicator.
The system shows template indicators: opportunities using it, applications processed, approval rate, closure rate and average evaluation with pass rate.
The system shows per-stage performance: time limit, average actual duration, current, late, completed, returned and closed.
On an opportunity, the user selects a template and «تطبيق»; the system asks for confirmation that stages and criteria will be replaced.
The system copies the template's stages and criteria into the opportunity, keeping supervisors per stage, and confirms «تم تطبيق «…» على الفرصة».
alternative_flows: If the user tries to delete a template used by opportunities, the system refuses with «لا يمكن حذف محرك تستخدمه فرص».
If applications or evaluations already exist on the opportunity, the system warns or blocks applying a template (To be confirmed).
business_requirements: The system must list templates of the user's organization with their stages, criteria, pass score and usage.
The system must create new templates with a pass score of 70% and three standard stages of 5 days each.
The system must allow editing the template name, description, pass score, stage names, approval types and time limits, and criteria (To be confirmed for variable number of stages).
The system must not allow deleting a template used by any opportunity.
The system must copy a template into an opportunity rather than reference it; later template changes do not alter existing opportunities.
The system must keep all stage settings when applying a template, including committee details and allowed actions, and keep existing supervisors per stage.
The system must warn or block applying a template when the opportunity has applications or evaluations (To be confirmed).
The system must apply a template completely or not at all.
The system must show template performance indicators and per-stage performance, flagging stages whose average duration exceeds the time limit.
The system must record template changes with an evidence document in the configuration history.

errors.name: Template in use
errors.description: Deleting a template used by opportunities is refused with «لا يمكن حذف محرك تستخدمه فرص».

errors.name: Template not found
errors.description: If the template does not exist, the system shows «المحرك غير موجود.»

use_cases.postconditions: Templates are maintained in the library and opportunities can adopt a standard workflow in one step.

use_cases.name: Manage the product catalog and product grant opportunities
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want to maintain a catalog of ready products with unit, price and stock, offer selected products in product opportunities and track their movement so that partners request only available items and stock is planned.
use_cases.description: The organization keeps a catalog of in-kind products with unit, unit price and quantity in stock. For a product opportunity, the Grants Manager selects which catalog products are offered. Partners can request up to the available quantity; stock is deducted at final approval and the request is then delivered. Each product has a history of requested, approved and delivered quantities by month, opportunity and region.
preconditions: The user is authorised to maintain the product catalog (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user opens «منتجات المنح», or the «المنتجات» tab of a product opportunity.
scenario: The system lists catalog products with name, description, unit, unit price and stock.
In edit mode, the user adds a product with name, description, unit, unit price and stock, or updates unit, price and stock of existing products.
The user saves the catalog edit session with the evidence document (see PRG-10).
On a product opportunity, the user ticks the catalog products offered, seeing price per unit and stock.
A partner requests quantities of offered products; the system refuses quantities above the available stock.
At final approval, the system checks stock again, deducts the approved quantities and marks the request awaiting delivery.
On delivery, the system records the delivered quantities.

The user opens a product to see current stock, requested, approved and delivered quantities and values, partners, monthly movement, comparison between opportunities and the list of requests containing it.
alternative_flows: If the catalog is empty, the system shows «الكتالوج فارغ — أضف أول منتج.»
If a product has been requested before, it cannot be deleted and is archived instead (Recommended).
business_requirements: The system must require a product name, and must allow unit from a fixed list, unit price and stock quantity.
The system must keep the catalog per organization and allow linking products to product opportunities, each product at most once per opportunity.
The system must not allow a partner to request more than the available stock.
The system must check stock at final approval and block or flag approval when stock is insufficient.
The system must deduct stock at final approval and never show negative stock (reservation timing to be confirmed).
The system must record delivered quantities per product on delivery (partial deliveries to be confirmed).
The system must not allow deleting a product referenced by any request; it must be archived instead, with confirmation.
The system must show product history: stock, requested, approved and delivered quantities with values, partners, top region, monthly movement and per-opportunity comparison.
The system must protect operational stock changes from being overwritten by catalog edit cancellations.

errors.name: Missing product name
errors.description: If the name is empty, the system shows «اسم المنتج مطلوب».

errors.name: Quantity above stock
errors.description: If a partner requests more than available, the system shows «الكمية المطلوبة من «…» تتجاوز المتاح (…)».

errors.name: No product selected
errors.description: If a partner submits without products, the system shows «اختر منتجاً واحداً على الأقل وحدد الكمية».

use_cases.postconditions: The catalog is accurate, product opportunities offer the right items, and stock reflects approvals and deliveries.

fields.notes: وحدة، جهاز، سلة، جلسة، شهر، كيلو، كتاب، رخصة

use_cases.name: Invite targeted partners to an opportunity
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want to send private invitations to the targeted partners and track their response so that the right partners respond to the opportunity and I can follow up.
use_cases.description: For opportunities targeted at named partners or partner groups, the Grants Manager sends private invitations. Each partner receives at most one invitation per opportunity with a personal link. The system tracks whether the invitation was sent, opened, answered with an offer or declined, and whether the partner's account is activated.
preconditions: The opportunity targets named partners or partner groups.
The user is authorised to send invitations (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user opens the «الدعوات» tab and selects «إرسال الدعوات (n)».
scenario: The system shows how many targeted partners have not yet been invited.
The user selects «إرسال الدعوات (n)».
The system creates one invitation per targeted partner not yet invited and sends it to the partner's email.
The system confirms «تم إرسال n دعوة».
The system lists invitations with partner, email, sent date, account activation and status.
The user copies an invitation link or opens it.
When the partner opens the link, submits an offer or declines, the system updates the invitation status.
alternative_flows: If all targeted partners are already invited, the system shows «كل الجهات المستهدفة مدعوة مسبقاً».
If no named partners or groups are targeted, the system shows «حدد جهات بالاسم أو مجموعة في الاستهداف أولاً».
business_requirements: The system must send invitations only to named or group-targeted partners.
The system must create at most one invitation per partner and opportunity.
The system must deliver invitations by email using the organization's message templates.
The system must give each invitation a unique, unguessable personal link.
The system must track invitation status: sent, opened, offer submitted, declined, with dates.
The system must show whether the invited partner's account is activated.
The system must define whether invitations apply to all opportunity kinds or only tendered projects, and whether invited partners may apply outside the window (To be confirmed).

errors.name: No targets
errors.description: If the opportunity has no named partners or groups, the system shows «حدد جهات بالاسم أو مجموعة في الاستهداف أولاً».

use_cases.postconditions: Targeted partners are invited and their responses are tracked.

use_cases.name: Define a tendered project (RFP) and award it to the best offer
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want to specify a tendered project, compare the offers received and award it to one offer so that the contract and project are created and the other bidders are informed.
use_cases.description: For a tendered project the foundation defines the scope of work, deliverables, implementation duration, weighted activities and a payment plan expressed as percentages of the winning offer. Invited partners submit offers within the budget ceiling. The Grants Manager compares offers by price and evaluation score and awards the project to one offer; the system creates the contract and project with the planned activities and payments and closes the other offers with an apology.
preconditions: The opportunity is of kind tendered project (مشروع مطروح).
The user is authorised to define and award tendered projects (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user opens the «تفاصيل المشروع» or «العروض والترسية» tab of a tendered project.
scenario: In edit mode, the user enters the scope of work, required deliverables and implementation duration.
The user adds activities with weights, marking those linked to a payment, and payment milestones with a percentage and days after award.
The user selects «حفظ تفاصيل المشروع»; the system checks that activity weights and payment percentages each total 100%.
Invited partners submit offers; the system rejects any offer above the budget ceiling.
The system shows offer cards with partner, reference, status, financial offer (lowest marked), average evaluation score against the pass score and the technical offer.
The user opens an offer for full review and evaluation.
The user selects «ترسية» on an evaluated, passing offer and confirms.
The system awards the offer, closes all other pending offers with an automatic apology, creates the contract (when required) and the project, and creates its activities and payments.
The system confirms «تمت الترسية وإنشاء المشروع».
alternative_flows: If no offers have been received, the system shows «لا توجد عروض بعد».
Once an offer is awarded, the award action is no longer available on any offer.
business_requirements: The system must capture scope of work, deliverables, implementation duration, weighted activities and payment milestones for tendered projects.
The system must require activity weights to total 100% and payment percentages to total 100% when present.
The system must show the tender details to invited partners.
The system must treat the opportunity budget as the financial ceiling and reject offers above it.
The system must show offers side by side with financial offer, lowest offer marker, evaluation score and pass indication.
The system must allow awarding only one offer per tendered project, and only an offer that is still pending.
The system must allow award only to offers that completed evaluation and passed, by an authorised role (To be confirmed whether committee approval is mandatory).
The system must, on award, close all other offers as not awarded with the reason «نشكر اهتمامكم، تمت ترسية المشروع على عرض آخر» and notify their partners.
The system must, on award, create the contract (when required) and the project, with payments calculated as the milestone percentage of the winning amount and due dates counted from the award date.
The system must perform the award as one complete operation; partial awards must not occur.

errors.name: Totals not 100%
errors.description: The system shows «مجموع أوزان الأنشطة يجب أن يكون 100%» or «مجموع نسب الدفعات يجب أن يكون 100%».

errors.name: Offer above ceiling
errors.description: In the portal the system shows «العرض المالي يتجاوز السقف …».

errors.name: Award failure
errors.description: If the award cannot be completed, the system shows the error and no offer is awarded.

use_cases.name: Govern configuration changes with evidence, rollback and history
use_cases.title: As a Grants Manager, I want configuration changes to opportunities, workflow templates and the product catalog to require an evidence document and to be reversible and traceable so that every change is justified and auditable.
use_cases.description: Opportunity, template and catalog configuration is view-only by default. Selecting «تعديل» starts an edit session; changes are confirmed only when the user attaches a supporting document and optionally a reason. The user can discard the session to return to the previous configuration. Every confirmed session is logged with before and after values, the actor, date, note and document.
preconditions: The user is authorised to change the configuration (To be confirmed).
use_cases.trigger: The user selects «تعديل» on an opportunity, a workflow template or the product catalog.
scenario: The system enables the editable controls and shows «وضع التعديل — التغييرات لا تُعتمد إلا بإرفاق المستند الشاهد».
The user makes the configuration changes.
The user selects «حفظ التعديلات».
The system opens «تأكيد التعديلات» asking for the supporting document and an optional reason.
The system runs an advisory AI check on the document.
The user selects «اعتماد وحفظ».
The system confirms the changes, records them with before and after values, actor, date, reason and document, and shows «حُفظت التعديلات ووُثّقت في السجل».
The user reviews the change history and opens the supporting documents.
alternative_flows: If nothing changed, the system shows «لا توجد تغييرات» and exits edit mode.
If the user selects «تراجع», the system restores the configuration as it was before the session and shows «تم التراجع عن التعديلات».
If the user selects «رجوع للتعديل», the user returns to editing.
business_requirements: The system must show configuration in view-only mode by default.
The system must require a supporting document to confirm configuration changes; a reason is optional.
The system must detect sessions without changes and not log them.
The system must record each confirmed session with before and after values, actor, date, reason and document.
The system must allow discarding a session and restoring the previous configuration.
The system must apply configuration changes to live data only when the session is confirmed, so that cancelling never overwrites operational data such as stock or stage movements.
The system must route publication changes through the same governance, or explicitly exempt them (To be confirmed).
The system must show the configuration history with date, actor, reason and a document that can be opened.

errors.name: Missing evidence
errors.description: If no document is attached, the system shows «المستند الشاهد إلزامي لحفظ التعديلات» and keeps «اعتماد وحفظ» disabled.

errors.name: Rollback failure
errors.description: If the previous configuration cannot be restored, the system shows «تعذر التراجع».

errors.name: Document cannot be opened
errors.description: If a history document cannot be retrieved, the system shows «تعذر فتح المستند».

use_cases.postconditions: Configuration changes are either confirmed with evidence and logged, or fully discarded.

business_rules.rule: Every opportunity has exactly one kind: project grant, product (in-kind) grant or tendered project (RFP), chosen at creation.
An opportunity is open for applications only when it is active, published and the current time is within its reception window.
Creating an opportunity requires a title, a budget greater than zero and a reception end after its start.
New opportunities receive the standard three-stage workflow (receive 3 days, study by criteria 5 days, approve 3 days) and three criteria (objectives 30%, impact 40%, financial feasibility 30%).
New opportunities default to: account types «جمعية أهلية» and «مؤسسة أهلية», one application per partner and a pass score of 80%.
On a general opportunity the applicant chooses the plan initiative; on an initiative-specific opportunity the application is charged to the opportunity's default plan item.
An opportunity is closed early only by switching it to inactive; reaching the end of the window closes reception without changing its status.
Partners named explicitly or belonging to a targeted group are always eligible; if only names or groups are targeted, all other partners are ineligible.
All other targeting rules (account type, classification, sub-classification, region, governorate/city, minimum governance) must all be met; an empty rule means all.
A partner without a governance score fails any minimum governance rule.
A partner may hold at most the allowed number of non-cancelled applications per opportunity.
Each stage has an approval type (supervisors, criteria or committee) and a time limit in days; an application exceeding the time limit is late.
A committee stage has a committee name and secretary; its applications are approved by the secretary with one set of minutes.
Default allowed actions per stage: return, close, return to applicant and attach file allowed; skip stage and edit application not allowed.
Evaluation criteria weights total 100%; an evaluation at or above the pass score is passing.
An opportunity uses at most one form from the organization's form library.

When an approved application becomes a project, a contract is created only if required, the default project manager is assigned, and the plan item of the application (or the opportunity default) is charged.
Applying a workflow template copies its stages and criteria into the opportunity; later template changes do not affect it.
A workflow template used by any opportunity cannot be deleted.
A partner cannot request more of a product than its available stock; stock is deducted at final approval and the request then awaits delivery.
Product grants do not produce contracts or projects; their outcome is delivery of the approved quantities.
Each partner receives at most one invitation per opportunity; invitations go only to named or group-targeted partners.
A tendered project's budget is the ceiling for offers; activity weights and payment percentages each total 100%.
Only one offer can be awarded per tendered project; all other pending offers are closed as not awarded with an automatic apology.
Configuration changes to opportunities, templates and the product catalog are confirmed only with a supporting document and are logged with before and after values.

gaps.gap: New opportunities are published immediately; there is no draft state or publish checklist, and the list's publish switch bypasses evidence.
gaps.impact: Incomplete opportunities can be visible to partners and receive applications.
gaps.recommendation: Create opportunities as drafts and publish only after a completeness check (form, criteria, targeting), through governed action.

gaps.gap: Any staff user reaching the grants section can create and change opportunities, templates and products, publish and award tenders.
gaps.recommendation: Restrict configuration and award to authorised roles and enforce it server-side.

gaps.gap: Deleting a catalog product is immediate, without confirmation, and erases past requests and deliveries of that product.
gaps.recommendation: Block deletion of referenced products, use archiving and confirmation.

gaps.gap: An offer can be awarded at any stage without evaluation, pass score or committee approval, and the award can be left half-done on failure.
gaps.impact: Non-compliant awards and inconsistent contracts and projects.
gaps.recommendation: Gate award on completed evaluation and authority; perform it as one complete operation.

gaps.gap: Eligibility, reception window and quota are checked only on screen; invitation links can open the application without checks.
gaps.impact: Ineligible or late applications can be submitted.
gaps.recommendation: Enforce all rules at submission and re-check on invitation links.

gaps.gap: Stock is not reserved and is not re-checked at approval; shortages are hidden by clamping to zero.
gaps.recommendation: Check stock at approval, block or flag shortages, consider reservation.

gaps.gap: Changes are written live during editing and cancelling restores a snapshot, which can overwrite operational changes made meanwhile.
gaps.impact: Stock or workflow data can be silently reverted.
gaps.recommendation: Apply configuration only on confirmation, or restrict rollback to configuration data.

gaps.gap: Criteria weights not totalling 100%, pass scores outside 0–100, invalid windows, zero budgets or zero quota can be saved after creation.
gaps.recommendation: Apply the same validation on every save and before publishing.

gaps.gap: Workflows are fixed at three stages; templates only allow editing time limits and criteria; stages and criteria can change while applications are in progress.
gaps.impact: Processes cannot match business needs and in-flight applications may change rules mid-way.
gaps.recommendation: Confirm need for variable stages; lock or version workflows once applications exist.

gaps.gap: Applying a template drops committee details and several allowed-action settings and can delete criteria used by evaluations.
gaps.impact: Loss of committee routing and evaluation data.
gaps.recommendation: Copy all stage settings and warn or block when evaluations exist.

gaps.gap: The 'edit application' and 'attach file' stage switches, the announcement date, free-text eligibility and contract officer have no effect elsewhere.
gaps.impact: Users configure settings that do nothing.
gaps.recommendation: Confirm purpose and implement, or remove.

gaps.gap: The general/initiative-specific flag is set only at creation and is not shown or editable later.
gaps.impact: Mistakes cannot be corrected; users cannot see how applications are charged to the plan.
gaps.recommendation: Show the flag and allow editing while no applications exist.

gaps.gap: Opportunities of all organizations are listed, new opportunities are created under a fixed organization, and some staff lists are not filtered by organization.
gaps.recommendation: Scope all lists and creation to the user's organization.

gaps.gap: The «مستهدفة» badge appears on almost every opportunity; summary stage names and template lateness use generic values.
gaps.recommendation: Align badge and summary logic; use each opportunity's own stages and limits.

gaps.gap: Invitations are not emailed; only a copyable link exists.
gaps.recommendation: Send invitations by email/SMS using organization templates.

gaps.gap: Opportunity budget is not checked against the annual plan item's available balance.
gaps.recommendation: Confirm whether budget must be bound to plan availability.

gaps.gap: The opportunities list has no search, filters or sorting, and criteria/catalog rows are deleted without confirmation and cannot be edited or reordered.
gaps.recommendation: Add search/filter/sort, confirmations, inline edit and ordering.

open_questions: Which roles may create, edit, publish and close opportunities, maintain templates and products, send invitations and award tendered projects?
Should new opportunities start as unpublished drafts, and is an approval required before publishing?
May the opportunity kind or the general/initiative-specific flag change after creation, and under what conditions?
Must workflow templates support a variable number of stages and editable approval types, and should template changes reach opportunities (versioning)?
What should happen when a template is applied, or stages and criteria edited, while applications or evaluations exist?
When should product stock be reserved or deducted (submission, approval, delivery), and are partial deliveries allowed?
Must eligibility be re-checked at review time as well as at submission?
What are the announcement date, the free-text eligibility conditions and the default contract officer used for?
Must an opportunity budget be limited by the available balance of its annual plan initiative?
What is the tender award policy: is evaluation or committee approval mandatory, is a minimum pass score required, and how are price and quality traded off?
Are invitations for all opportunity kinds or only tendered projects, and may invited partners apply outside the window or when unpublished?
Is the distinction between 'single supervisor' and 'all supervisors' approval required?
Which application statuses count towards the per-partner quota?
For general opportunities, may the selectable initiatives be restricted to a subset of the plan?
Should opportunities close automatically at the end of the reception window, and what are the rules to extend or reopen them?
What targets (e.g. SLA compliance) should template and product analytics be measured against?
